entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A person wearing a bulky white extravehicular suit, carrying a large white rectangular backpack, with dark red bands on the legs, facing away from the camera and extending a hand to contact the module section on the right.

entities.name: planetary background
entities.identification: The distant planetary surface behind Person A and the module section, with light-blue regions, white cloud bands, and a bright curved edge.

entities.name: black outer-space background
entities.identification: The large deep-black region outside the planet's illuminated surface and the foreground person and equipment.

entities.name: gold foil-covered equipment assembly
entities.identification: The gold box-shaped foil-covered equipment and adjacent support partially visible below the end face of the module section in the first frame.

entities.name: silver-blue cylindrical module section
entities.identification: The large module section on the right with a dark-blue curved sidewall, a silver partitioned and striped end face, and an orange-gold ring-shaped handrail.
